notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Thank you for all your feedback, positive or negative. We are here for the long run and you can rest assured we will get around to every item. We take every comment as equally important as the people who work for us.
The first stage, Grind, is really just a base set of features that we are using to build the next stage. We have decided to add all the fixes and requests into a major update, along with the StoryMode stage release.  
Once you play StoryMode then everything will make more sense, such as, who are these strange colored people? What happened to Aussie4x4? And where is TraxWorld set and located?
We are getting close to the new build, currently aiming for the end of Feb or early March 22'. 
Thank you for your patience and support towards our community,
Team TraxWorld
